summary: Sprint 16.1 — Professional Trading Panel (MT5 Style) frontend testing on Expo web preview. MOSTLY GREEN with TWO HIGH-severity bugs. GREEN: (1) Order-type MARKET/LIMIT/STOP tab selector renders with all 3 testIDs (order-type-market/limit/stop). (2) Market BUY 0.01 EURUSD → window.confirm 'Position opened. BUY 0.01 EUR/USD @ 1.1276965' fires → position appears in 'Open Positions' card with testID pos-<uuid> → tapping opens PositionSheet with ALL required testIDs (sheet-tp, sheet-sl, sheet-save-tpsl, partial-25, partial-50, partial-75, partial-custom, partial-custom-go, sheet-reverse, sheet-double, sheet-close). (3) TP/SL modification via sheet saved cleanly (backend 200). (4) Partial close 50% shows 'Close 50% of BUY 0.01?' confirm dialog and executes. (5) Estimates row on Place Order card shows all 4 lines: Margin required (₹100), Est. commission (₹0), Est. spread cost (₹187.18), Total est. cost (₹187.18), plus Swap and Balance after margin. (6) 'Risk / Reward' row appears the moment both tp-input and sl-input are non-empty (verified '1 : 1.00' with tp=1.13, sl=1.11). (7) chart-indicators-btn opens Indicators modal, ind-ema and ind-rsi toggle rows are present. (8) chart-tools-btn expands tools row with tool-hline/vline/rect/fib/text/erase visible. (9) GET /api/forex/chart-objects?symbol_id=EURUSD&chart_key=main returns 200 with 1+ persisted objects (backend persistence proven). (10) Multi-Chart Workspace button on Forex tab (testID multi-chart-btn) → /forex/multi-chart. All 4 layout buttons (layout-single/dual_v/dual_h/quad) present and switch layouts. pane-symbol-0 opens symbol picker; pick-XAUUSD swaps that pane's symbol to XAUUSD; XAUUSD PERSISTS after full page reload. (11) Admin SPA /api/admin-ui/#/forex-settings shows Trading Costs card and 'Commission Collected' report section with the correct copy. RED: (A) HIGH — no pending-price-input rendered when order type is LIMIT or STOP; the `pendingPrice` React state exists in symbol/[id].tsx but no TextInput is ever mounted for it, so users cannot enter a pending price and the entire LIMIT/STOP order flow (and Pending Orders card + cancel-order-{id}) is unreachable through the UI. (B) HIGH — RSI oscillator sub-pane does NOT become visible: after toggling ind-rsi from the modal, the #osc element inside the chart iframe has `className=''` (not 'visible') and `offsetHeight=1`; the sub-pane never expands under the chart. Regression: Live poll every 5s intact, chart iframe loads clean (7 canvases + legend + volume), no red screens, no /api 5xx, existing trade markers overlay from prior regression runs is present (expected, not a bug).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing pending-price-input UI: `pendingPrice` state is declared (line 38) and used in placeOrder() when orderType !== 'market' (line 151), but there is NO TextInput rendered in JSX to capture that value. Result: selecting LIMIT or STOP tab shows no input row → user cannot place a pending order at all. Add a conditional TextInput with testID='pending-price-input' between the order-type selector and the Buy/Sell block that appears only when orderType !== 'market'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/forex/symbol/[id].tsx:242-252 (order-type block) — a pending-price row must be inserted immediately after.

Toggling ind-rsi (or any sub-pane oscillator) does not surface the #osc sub-pane. In the chart iframe after ind-rsi toggle: `document.getElementById('osc').className === ''` (expected 'visible') and `offsetHeight === 1`. Either (a) setIndicator postMessage isn't reaching the iframe, or (b) the iframe handler is not adding the 'visible' class / not resizing #osc. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TradingChart.tsx:277-288 (toggleIndicator + send) and /app/backend/static/chart/index.html (osc element + visibility toggle).

integration_issues.flow: Place LIMIT/STOP order → Pending Orders card → cancel-order-{id}
integration_issues.issue: Untestable end-to-end because pending-price-input is missing from the DOM (see UI bug above). Backend endpoint placePendingOrder exists and is wired in forexApi, but no UI path leads to it.

action_items:
FIX (HIGH): Add a conditional pending-price TextInput to /app/frontend/app/forex/symbol/[id].tsx after the order-type selector (around line 252). Example:

{orderType !== 'market' ? (
  <View>
    <Text style={t.label}>{orderType === 'limit' ? 'LIMIT PRICE' : 'STOP PRICE'}</Text>
    <TextInput value={pendingPrice} onChangeText={setPendingPrice} keyboardType='decimal-pad' placeholder={`e.g. ${q ? (side === 'buy' ? q.ask : q.bid).toFixed(symbol.price_decimals) : ''}`} placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted} testID='pending-price-input' style={[t.input, { color: palette.textPrimary, borderColor: palette.border, backgroundColor: palette.surface, marginTop: 6 }]} />

  </View>

Also disable the place-order button when orderType!=='market' && !parseFloat(pendingPrice).

FIX (HIGH): RSI sub-pane not showing. Inspect /app/backend/static/chart/index.html and chart-tools.js for the {type:'setIndicator', id, enabled} handler and confirm it (a) toggles document.getElementById('osc').classList and (b) re-invokes the chart's resize handler. Also verify TradingChart.tsx sends the setIndicator message even when the modal is closed via backdrop tap and that the iframe is loaded before the postMessage is sent (queue messages until 'ready').
OPTIONAL: While fixing (1), also gate the place-order button label to include the entered pending price when orderType !== 'market' so the user sees a preview of the exact order that will be sent.
critical_code_review_comments: symbol/[id].tsx line 37-38 declares orderType + pendingPrice state and lines 145-160 handle the pending-order submission, but the render block at 242-252 only wires up the order-type tabs — the pendingPrice TextInput was clearly omitted from the render tree. Easy fix, high visibility bug.

PositionSheet.tsx testIDs are complete and stable (sheet-tp, sheet-sl, sheet-save-tpsl, partial-25/50/75, partial-custom, sheet-reverse, sheet-double, sheet-close). Confirmation dialogs (window.confirm) fire correctly on web for partial/reverse/double/close per Sprint 15.1 Alert fix pattern — good.
multi-chart.tsx testIDs (layout-*, pane-symbol-*, pick-*) all render and workspace is persisted server-side (XAUUSD survived a hard reload).

TradingChart.tsx toggleIndicator posts the message but there is no visible acknowledgement/log; also the modal closes with Escape but on backdrop tap the sequence Pressable style={s.modalBg} → Pressable style={s.modalCard} may swallow taps in odd cases. rca_of_issue:
BUG 1 (pending-price-input): Root cause is a JSX omission in symbol/[id].tsx — the developer added `orderType` and `pendingPrice` state, hooked pendingPrice into placeOrder(), and even added the 3-way order-type tab selector, but forgot to add the actual pending-price TextInput between the tab selector and the Buy/Sell buttons. Reproduction: on symbol page, tap LIMIT or STOP → observe zero new UI elements between order-type tabs and Buy/Sell buttons; place-order still fires but throws 'Enter a valid pending price' because pendingPrice=''. Fix: add the conditional TextInput per action item #1.
BUG 2 (RSI osc): Root cause not fully isolated — TradingChart.tsx correctly calls `send({ type: 'setIndicator', id, enabled, params })`, but inside the iframe the #osc element remains className='' and offsetHeight=1 after the toggle. Likely candidates: (a) the iframe's message handler for `setIndicator` does not add the 'visible' class to #osc, (b) postMessage is fired before the iframe has attached its listener (no ready-queue), (c) the CSS rule `.visible` on #osc is missing / does not expand height. Suggest instrumenting inside /app/backend/static/chart/index.html: on receipt of setIndicator, `console.log('[chart] setIndicator', msg); if (needsOsc) document.getElementById('osc').classList.add('visible');` and confirm.
